sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host New Mills on Tuesday at Hind Heath Road with a 7:45pm kick-off in what promises to be a competitive encounter. Both teams currently sit on 6 points in the table after three matches, making this a crucial fixture in the early season battle. The Bach will be looking to build on their recent 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, while New Mills bounced back from a heavy 5-0 defeat to secure a 2-1 win last Saturday.
divisionWide: The division sees a fascinating set of matches across Tuesday evening. League leaders Wolverhampton Casuals travel to face third-placed Eccleshall in a potential title-race clash at Brinsford Stadium. AFC Bridgnorth, unbeaten and second in the table, face Wednesfield Community away, while Alsager Town welcome fourth-placed Stafford Town to Wood Park in another significant midweek encounter. Allscott Heath host Shawbury United in a local derby, and there's also a fixture between Market Drayton Town and Telford Town. These matches will significantly reshape the league standings as several teams look to maintain their impressive starts to the season.
